mission: Provide adaptive multi-horizon foresight, counterfactual simulation, evidence-ahead planning, automatic rerouting and recovery-aware decision support to Federation systems before consequential commitment.

naming.canonical_name: HORIZON-Ω — Adaptive Foresight & Strategic Simulation Engine
naming.legacy_alias_behavior: Preserve as profile/minimum-horizon shorthand only; not a fixed depth ceiling.

core_contract.stop_condition: Continue simulation until material uncertainty, dependency, countermove, proof and recovery branches are sufficiently resolved for the decision class or the configured safety ceiling is reached.

internal_sequence: rank by proof strength reversibility information gain and owner burden
execute or prepare strongest safe fallback
surface_to_owner_only_when: material strategy/risk change requiring owner decision

federation_profiles.FORMATION_ENGINE: route-family downstream-consequence simulation before route selection
federation_profiles.AO_HARMONIC: native cognitive-fabric integration and shared digital-twin host

inheritance.all_registered_federation_systems: eligible and recommended; required for consequential strategy/decision work once their adapter is activated
inheritance.new_systems: inherit HORIZON-Ω through AO-HARMONIC or a compatible adapter at bootstrap
